findings.title: Item resume cannot reselect flagged slices from `slices-plan`
findings.description: `_select_item` only proceeds when the item appears in the freshly evaluated source; otherwise it rejects the request unless the slice is complete and already merged. The `slices-plan` pipeline uses `cf.undesigned_slices`, which excludes a slice once its design file exists. A slice whose design was created but whose review loop later flagged it therefore disappears from the source, preventing `--item ... --decision retry` or `accept` from resuming it. The planning-batch test does not catch this because its fake source continues returning the slice as undesigned.

findings.title: Malformed report items can escape the documented load error
findings.description: The `cast` calls do not validate JSON at runtime. For example, a report with the supported `schemaVersion` but `"items": ["x"]` reaches `BatchItemRecord.from_json`, where the string’s missing `.get` method raises `AttributeError`. That exception is not converted to `BatchReportLoadError`, despite `BatchReport.load` documenting that any malformed report raises that error; item resume can consequently terminate with an unexpected traceback instead of a clean rejection.
